info.title: PPC Research API
info.description: Discover precisely which keywords any competitor targets in paid search. Clearly understand their real business focus and profit model, regardless of website messaging.

get.description:
Returns the most successful paid search keywords for a domain based on search volume and competitive strength. This endpoint provides the highest-performing PPC keywords from the past year to identify proven ad opportunities and optimize keyword strategy.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/keywords?query=amazon.com)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Domain or URL to analyze for successful PPC keywords.

parameters.name: excludeDomain
parameters.description: Domain to exclude from keyword results.

parameters.name: includeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated terms that must be present in keyword results.

parameters.name: includeAnyTerm
parameters.description: Match logic for includeTerms: true for ANY term match, false for ALL terms required.

parameters.name: excludeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated terms that must not be present in keyword results.

parameters.name: searchVolume.min
parameters.description: Minimum monthly search volume filter for Google.com.

parameters.name: searchVolume.max
parameters.description: Maximum monthly search volume filter for Google.com.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Metric to sort results by.

x-enumDescriptions.PercentMobileSearches: Percentage of searches from mobile devices
x-enumDescriptions.PercentDesktopSearches: Percentage of searches from desktop devices
x-enumDescriptions.PercentSearchesNotClicked: Percentage of searches resulting in no clicks
x-enumDescriptions.PercentPaidClicks: Percentage of clicks going to paid results
x-enumDescriptions.PercentOrganicClicks: Percentage of clicks going to organic results
x-enumDescriptions.BroadCostPerClick: Broad match cost per click estimate
x-enumDescriptions.PhraseCostPerClick: Phrase match cost per click estimate
x-enumDescriptions.ExactCostPerClick: Exact match cost per click estimate
x-enumDescriptions.BroadMonthlyClicks: Estimated monthly clicks for broad match
x-enumDescriptions.PhraseMonthlyClicks: Estimated monthly clicks for phrase match
x-enumDescriptions.ExactMonthlyClicks: Estimated monthly clicks for exact match
x-enumDescriptions.BroadMonthlyCost: Estimated monthly cost for broad match
x-enumDescriptions.PhraseMonthlyCost: Estimated monthly cost for phrase match
x-enumDescriptions.ExactMonthlyCost: Estimated monthly cost for exact match

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction for results.

x-enumDescriptions.Ascending: Sort from lowest to highest values
x-enumDescriptions.Descending: Sort from highest to lowest values

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Row number to start the results with.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search.  Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.).

parameters.name: adultFilter
parameters.description: Filter out adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

200.description: Successfully retrieved most successful PPC keywords. Returns keyword data with search metrics, cost estimates, and competitive intelligence showing the domain's highest-performing paid keywords.

schema.description: Response wrapper containing PPC keyword research data with detailed advertising performance metrics and pagination metadata for keyword discovery and optimization.

totalMatchingResults.description: Total number of PPC keywords available that match the query criteria, including results not included in the current page.

results.description: Array of PPC keywords with comprehensive advertising performance metrics including search volume, cost data, and competitive intelligence insights.

keyword.description: The keyword that shows high performance or profitability for successful competitors in paid search ad.

searchVolume.description: Estimated monthly search volume for this keyword based on Google search data across the selected country/region, blended from multiple sources for accuracy.

liveSearchVolume.description: Adjusted search volume based on recent trends and real-time data, providing a more current estimate than historical averages.

rankingDifficulty.description: SEO difficulty score (0-100) indicating how challenging it would be to rank organically for this keyword, with 100 being most difficult.

totalMonthlyClicks.description: Total estimated monthly clicks (both organic and paid) generated from search results for this keyword.

percentMobileSearches.description: Percentage of searches for this keyword that originate from mobile devices (0.0-1.0).

percentDesktopSearches.description: Percentage of searches for this keyword that originate from desktop devices (0.0-1.0).

percentSearchesNotClicked.description: Percentage of searches where users leave the SERP without clicking any result, often due to sufficient information in featured snippets or direct answers (0.0-1.0).

percentPaidClicks.description: Percentage of total SERP clicks that go to paid ad results (0.0-1.0).

percentOrganicClicks.description: Percentage of total SERP clicks that go to organic search results (0.0-1.0).

broadCostPerClick.description: Average cost-per-click for broad match keyword targeting, representing what advertisers typically pay when their ads are triggered by related keywords.

phraseCostPerClick.description: Average cost-per-click for phrase match keyword targeting, where ads show for searches that include the keyword phrase in the same order.

exactCostPerClick.description: Average cost-per-click for exact match keyword targeting, the most precise and typically highest-performing match type.

broadMonthlyClicks.description: Estimated monthly paid clicks for broad match targeting of this keyword.

phraseMonthlyClicks.description: Estimated monthly paid clicks for phrase match targeting of this keyword.

exactMonthlyClicks.description: Estimated monthly paid clicks for exact match targeting of this keyword.

broadMonthlyCost.description: Estimated monthly ad spend for broad match targeting of this keyword.

phraseMonthlyCost.description: Estimated monthly ad spend for phrase match targeting of this keyword.

exactMonthlyCost.description: Estimated monthly ad spend for exact match targeting of this keyword.

paidCompetitors.description: Total number of unique advertisers observed purchasing ads for this keyword over the last 14 months, indicating competitive intensity.

distinctCompetitors.description: List of domain names that have purchased ads for this keyword over the last 14 months.

rankingHomepages.description: Number of domain homepages (root URLs) ranking within the first 100 organic search results for this keyword.

serpFeaturesCsv.description: Comma-separated list of SERP features present for this keyword (e.g., Images, Videos, Maps, Shopping), indicating competition for organic real estate.

serpFirstResult.description: Domain name of the top-ranking organic result for this keyword, useful for identifying category leaders.

isQuestion.description: Indicates whether this keyword is phrased as a question (who, what, when, where, why, how).

isNotSafeForWork.description: Indicates whether this keyword is flagged as containing adult or inappropriate content.

items.description: Represents a PPC keyword with comprehensive advertising performance metrics including search volume, cost analysis, competitive intelligence, and SERP characteristics for paid search campaign optimization.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., invalid domain format, search volume ranges, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access PPC keyword data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

Basic_Authentication_Token.description:
Basic Authentication is a standard that involves encoding your SPYFU_API_ID:SECRET_KEY into a Base64 string. Your SpyFu API ID and Secret Key can both be found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page. Additionally, you can find the Base64 string has been pre-generated on the same page under Base 64 Key. Finally, this encoded string is sent in the "Authorization" header prefixed with the keyword "Basic":
For example, to authorize as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:AB12WXYZ the client would send
Authorization: Basic MDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwOkFCMTJXWFla

Query_Parameter_Token.description:
An API key can be added as a query parameter. Your API key is listed as "Secret Key" found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page
For example, to authorize with the API key AB12WXY
/apis/example_api/GetExample?domain=spyfu.com&api_key=AB12WXYZ
Query_Parameter_Token.name: api_key

HMAC_Authentication_Header.description:
For even more security, each request can be individually authenticated with a timestamped HMAC (Hash Message Authentication Code) signature. Composed of your secret key, a valid timestamp, the API request path, and all request parameters.

Creating the signature:


Combine the pieces that will be converted into the signature.
StringToSign =
	HTTP-Verb + "
" +
	Timestamp + "
" +
	UrlPath + "
"
	QueryParameters;

Create UTF-8 encodings of the above string and of your secret key.
byte[] SecretKeyBytes = UTF-8-Encoding-Of( Upper-Case-Of( SECRET_KEY ) );
byte[] StringToSignBytes = UTF-8-Encoding-Of( StringToSign );

Use an implementation of HMAC256 using your UTF-8 secret key to encode the combined string of your request. This should then be converted to Base64 to finish creating your signature.
Signature = Base64( HMAC-SHA256( SecretKeyBytes, StringToSignBytes ) );

Using the signature:


This signature is then sent in through an Authentication header with your username.
Authentication: UserName:Signature
HMAC_Authentication_Header.name: Authentication
